notes_for_editor: Thin record. Every construction and fate claim traces to the Kresek Inventory (cited by WillhiteWeb) or to pages that repeat it. The 1935 panoramas show a 20-foot tower that may be an earlier structure; no source says whether it was replaced in 1938. The sources were read in full; no staffing, fire or current-site description exists in them. The brief's record (L-4, gone, FFLOS 2012, elevation 1736.1 m) checks out, so no corrections. Access left out: no source gives a level. A WebSearch for the site turned up no new pages.
